sources.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
sources.findings: PCGrad projects a conflicting task gradient onto the plane normal to another task gradient. The authors explicitly state that negative gradient cosine alone does not establish harmful optimization: magnitude imbalance and curvature also matter. Their experiments do not validate Moshi character adaptation.
